tara: FYI opened a small docs PR updating the private deploy migration guide. It missed the edge-case where customers terminate via VPN-only egress — we need a short note.
evan: Good catch. We should explain that when egress is via an on-prem VPN appliance the installer needs the appliance IP in the allowed list and that SNAT may be required. Small snippet suggestion: `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source <vpn-egress-ip>`
joel: Add also a line about DNS: if the VPN intercepts DNS, you must point internal-redwood.<customer> to the cluster IP in the customer's DNS or /etc/hosts. I've seen TLS failures when SAN doesn't match.
tara: Agree. Can one of you add a 2-line SDK example showing how to override endpoint via env var in airgapped installs (so customers don't accidentally point at public api)?
evan: I'll add this snippet and a one-liner on certs: `export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://internal-redwood.mycorp.svc.cluster.local` then `redwood.Client(endpoint=os.getenv('REDWOOD_ENDPOINT'))`. Mention to include cluster CA in container trust store.
joel: Also flagged an internal-only link in KMS section. We should replace with ops public link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/kms/README.md#onprem-quickstart — I'll paste a minimal PKCS#11 example for HSMs.
joel: PKCS#11 example to paste: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L` and `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -l --pin 1234`. Call out that module path varies by vendor.
doc-bot: Link scan: replaced internal URL redwood-internal/kms-runbook with public ops README.
tara: Please keep all additions <8 lines. This is for the quickstart section only. Evan add the env var + TLS note, Joel add the PKCS#11 pair and vendor caveat, I'll run link check and merge.
evan: Pushed a tiny commit with env var and TLS note. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10432/files
joel: PKCS#11 and vendor note added. Also added a short FAQ bullet: "Why are my probes failing?" pointing to SNAT + DNS bullets.
tara: LGTM. Merging after CI link check. :shipit:
doc-bot: Auto-check passed. Merge scheduled.
